blocks.text: WGSL modules are assembled through engine imports, chunk registration and ShaderBuilder. Functions, structures and bindings below come directly from the checked-out shader files. A file can be a reusable include, an active entry point or a retained experimental/legacy variant; file presence alone does not establish that it executes in the default pipeline.

Follow the corresponding geometry, fragment and pass API before changing an entry point. CPU data offsets, WGSL alignment, bindings, varying interpolation, reversed depth and workgroup sizes must continue to agree.
